remainingDomainObligations.statement: Tenant DEK AES-256-GCM; unique nonce per key, tenant+generation and authenticated envelope; never select by slot alone.
New random key per slot reuse; exactly one ACTIVE; READY not usable; archive recovery and revoked deny; counters not proof migration complete.
DB-clock lease and monotonic token, guarded SQL in same transaction; primitive qualification not multi-pod worker or all-writer fence.
Separate global IAM key from tenant DEK; per-field AAD and separate HMAC keys; no plaintext fallback.
Initial email unverified; single-use purpose-bound proof; proof not login or permissions; old verified address current until new proof and atomic switch.
Freeze all legacy writers; verified backup/restore, bounded migration, zero residual plaintext and decryptability/HMAC checks before manual seal.
No cascade deletion of CRM/SALES evidence; pseudonymous refs not anonymous; external revocation pending until proved; no restore of deleted identity.
Tenant immutable file object, typed owner attachment and fresh object/PII authority; general FILES grant insufficient.
Bounded streaming, actual bytes digest, CLEAN only, scanner failure deny, no overwrite of available object.
Provider flag selects new staging only; use persisted provider; no auto migration, no silent fallback or corruption inference from outage.
Detach not physical delete; active references/hold/retention prevent deletion; private original not public.
Report-specific encrypted storage verification and atomic attachment/publication; old general plaintext decision not permission for report path.
Approved tenant retention 3–5 years, disabled default, strict cutoff, active legal hold excludes deletion, no blanket financial/consent purge.
Bounded deletion batches and common policy/hold advisory fence; row locator transaction-local; no auto partition drop.
Privacy erasure independent of retention; WAL/backups/external copies require own policy.
Valid active KATO for locations; geography not tenant identity; public directory no CRM PII.
Nullable paired GPS; immutable consistent origin snapshot at confirm, no invented legacy origin; scope review.
One entity, kk/ru/en/zh-Hans; IDs, currencies, quantities and states not translated; locale not region.
Requested/resolved locale and explicit fallback; critical documents/consent require approved language or explicit choice; no PII translation.
Invoice/payment/settlement/refund deferred; fulfillment not payment; preserve negative invariant.
Campaign dispatch deferred; existing consent and deny regression preserved.
Preserve entitlement, metering and renewal source obligations; no implied activation.
Verified backup/restore and minimal operations; separate G1–G4; no production from synthetic CI.
Forward additive migrations, preserve history/checksums, populated PG and recovery proof; no automatic seal.
